results.source: Notification 10/2019-CT (exemption for exclusive suppliers of goods up to Rs 40 lakh) - https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-10-central-tax-english-2019.pdf

Notification 10/2019-CT excludes intra-State suppliers in Telangana (and 9 other States/UTs) from the Rs 40 lakh limit, so the Rs 20 lakh goods limit applies - https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-10-central-tax-english-2019.pdf ; CBIC 'GST - An Update' (1 Apr 2019) lists the 10 States at Rs 20 lakh - https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/01042019_GST-An-Update.pdf

Manipur is one of the ten States with a Rs 20 lakh goods threshold (not Rs 10 lakh) - CBIC 'GST - An Update' https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/01042019_GST-An-Update.pdf ; Notification 10/2019-CT https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-10-central-tax-english-2019.pdf

Assam is not among the ten States excluded by Notification 10/2019-CT, so the general Rs 40 lakh goods threshold applies - https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-10-central-tax-english-2019.pdf ; CBIC 'GST - An Update' https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/01042019_GST-An-Update.pdf
Services threshold is Rs 20 lakh; Rs 10 lakh applies only in Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura - CBIC 'GST - An Update' (1 Apr 2019) https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/01042019_GST-An-Update.pdf

CGST Act s.24(i): inter-State taxable supply requires registration irrespective of turnover; the only turnover-based inter-State relief is for services (Notification 10/2017-IT) and notified handicrafts (Notification 3/2018-IT) - https://taxguru.in/?p=1029615 ; https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/01042019_GST-An-Update.pdf

Notification 14/2019-CT limits composition to Rs 75 lakh for Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura and Uttarakhand - https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-14-central-tax-english-2019.pdf
